title: Skeletron loot and presentation: mask, trophy, Skeletron Hand hook, Book of Skulls, Bone Glove bag, skull and slap cues
player_outcome: Beating Skeletron can drop the Skeletron Mask (1/7), the Skeletron Hand grappling hook (1/8), the Book of Skulls (1/8) and a trophy (1/10), plus 5–15 Lesser Healing Potions and 5 gold. The Expert bag adds the Bone Glove, which throws crossbones as you attack. Its skulls whistle, its slaps crack, and its spin roars.
design: New data/items/skeletron.json. skeletron_mask: armor, equipSlot head, defense 0, tags [vanity], rarity 1, value 7500.
skeletron_hand (item): category hook, rarity 2, value 20000, behaviors [{type grapple, reach 24, speed 25, pull 13, color #e8e0c8}].
bone_glove: accessory, rarity -12, tags [expert], equipEffects [{type attackProjectile, projectile bone_glove_bone, damage 25, cooldown 60}].
Projectile bone_glove_bone: friendly, visual item (bone), gravity 10, spinning, pierce 1.
New EffectSpec 'attackProjectile' {projectile, damage, cooldown, speed} in EffectSpecs.cs and EffectState.AttackProjectiles (list).

New partial src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Interaction/ItemUseSystem.Gloves.cs: LaunchAttackProjectiles(p, outcome). ItemUseSystem.Use calls it once after a successful weapon use (outcome Swung/Shot/Thrust). Cooldown per player via a new PlayerEntity.GloveCooldown decremented in GameWorld.TickPlayer. It fires along p.Aim from the hand height.
Loot (data/loot/bosses.json): skeletron = coins [45000,55000], lesser_healing_potion 5–15, skeletron_trophy 0.1, Classic → skeletron_drops, Expert → skeletron_treasure_bag.
skeletron_drops: skeletron_mask 1/7, skeletron_hand 1/8, book_of_skulls 1/8. The non-Terraria bone stack is removed. skeletron_bag = skeletron_drops + bone_glove.
The skeletron_trophy object is added to data/tileobjects/trophies.json.

Cues: HandBrain calls ctx.Cue(npc, 'hand_slap') at strike start. CryptWardenBrain calls ctx.Cue(npc, 'skull_shot') on each skull. tools/audio/sfx_recipes.py gains 'hand_slap' (bone clack plus thud) and 'skull_shot' (hollow whoosh with a rattle).

Blender assets.json: skeletron_mask uses the skeletron_skull generator at a radius of 0.17 m, hollowed. skeletron_hand item uses skeletron_hand_bones at size 0.3. bone_glove is a bone gauntlet (new 'bone_glove' generator in trophies.py). bone_glove_bone uses the 'bone' item generator. The trophy uses the 'trophy' generator.
Add bosses_pre2.GENERATORS to the item generator map in build_all.py so boss parts can be reused as item models.
Reference rows in tools/content/reference/items_extra.py: skeletron_mask, skeletron_hand, bone_glove, skeletron_trophy.
files_add: data/items/skeletron.json — mask, Skeletron Hand hook, Bone Glove, bone projectile
data_changes: Skeletron loot restructured to Terraria 1.4 Classic odds and an Expert bag.
tests: SkeletronTests.DropsFollowTerrariaOdds: roll skeletron_drops 2800 times with a fixed Pcg32; mask ≈ 1/7, hook ≈ 1/8, book ≈ 1/8 (±0.03).
GearTests.BoneGloveThrowsACrossboneOnAttackWithCooldown: two sword uses within 60 ticks give exactly one bone_glove_bone.
Smoke dungeon.cmds: 'give bone_glove 1', 'equip bone_glove', 'give copper_broadsword 1', 'wield copper_broadsword', 'use', 'assert projectiles.count >= 1'.
verification: Headless dungeon.cmds; view the new icons
risks: The Skeletron Hand hook only works once the items phase fixes grappling (audit F). Until then it behaves like the other hooks.
ItemUseSystem.cs (375 lines) is heavily edited by the items phase. Keep this to a single call line.
The mask is invisible on the body until armour rendering exists (audit K).
